name: Install Agent Windows
description: Install Sensu Go agent on Windows

package_source.description: Full MSI URL or local path for the Sensu Go agent installer. The MSI filename includes a build number that varies per release — find the current release at https://github.com/sensu/sensu-go/releases. URL pattern: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/sensu.io/sensu-go/<version>/sensu-go-agent_<version>.<build>_en-US.x64.msi
